catalog_name: GitHub Supported Secret Scanning Patterns (API Key & Token Reference)
attribution: GitHub Secret Scanning Documentation and Partner Pattern Catalog
scope: Strictly limited to API Keys and API Tokens. Generic passwords, certificates, SSH private keys, and database connection URIs are deliberately excluded.

patterns.name: AWS Access Key ID
patterns.limitations: Matches format of standard 20-character AWS Access Key ID. Does not verify whether IAM key is active or revoked.

patterns.name: OpenAI API Key
patterns.limitations: Covers both legacy sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{48} and project-scoped sk-proj-... formats.

patterns.name: NVIDIA NGC API Key
patterns.limitations: NGC and NVIDIA NIM inference catalog API keys.

patterns.name: GitHub Personal Access Token / OAuth Token
patterns.limitations: Matches modern GitHub token formats including ghp (personal), gho (OAuth), and ghs (server-to-server).

patterns.name: Google Cloud / Firebase API Key
patterns.limitations: Identifies standard 39-character AIza API key format for GCP, Maps, and Firebase.

patterns.name: Stripe Live / Restricted API Key
patterns.limitations: Targets production live secret keys (sk_live_) and restricted access keys (rk_live_).

patterns.name: Azure Storage / Cognitive Services API Key
patterns.limitations: Supports both Azure Storage AccountKey connection string secrets and Cognitive Services 32-hex keys.

patterns.name: Slack Bot / User API Token
patterns.character_set: Hyphen-delimited numeric account blocks followed by alphanumeric token
patterns.limitations: Standard Slack Bot (xoxb-) and User (xoxp-) token schemas.

patterns.name: Twilio API Key
patterns.limitations: Twilio developer API Key format starting with SK followed by 32 hex chars.

patterns.name: Generic High-Entropy API Key
patterns.character_set: High-entropy alphanumeric strings associated with API key assignment patterns
patterns.limitations: Identifies generic 32-64 character high-entropy tokens when associated with explicit API key identifiers.
